name: linux-diagnostics-without-secrets
purpose: On linux, the agent status reports what a supporter needs and the exported bundle contains logs but no credential or grant.

given.text: the HashRelay cloud is running with workspace w1
the HashRelay agent is installed per user on linux, by a non-administrator
the agent is paired to workspace w1 through the device-authorization flow as endpoint e1

when.text: the person asks the agent for its status
the agent exports a diagnostic bundle

then.text: the status names version, platform, endpoint id, connection, last registration, notification permission and start-at-login
the bundle contains recent logs and the status
the bundle contains no credential or grant
